name: @labofbabel/oomph
description: Orders Of Magnitude — a drag-to-navigate control for numbers far too big for a slider. Exact BigInt, with an experimental Float64 mode.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build: esbuild oomph.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/oomph.min.js --banner:js='/*! Oomph | MPL-2.0 | https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ | (c) 2026 Lior Ben-Gai */'

author: Lior Ben-Gai
